title: intent claude rules validate's help says it checks required sections, and it checks frontmatter only
body:
Found by cc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit's rules pass.

Seen: `intent claude rules validate --help` says it will "Validate frontmatter and required sections" (`surface/dispatch-table.json`); `validate` checks frontmatter only (`rules.rs:764-860`), and no section is required by it. It was found after the audit's register landing (90684455f), so it waits for the next register batch.

Expected: the help says what `validate` checks.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- low, filed for after the stabilisation line.


Fixed in 3.2.2 by `1d1659464` (vc, 2026-09-25): the commit message names the bank, its patch-id and the judge.
